# The allele record — hypothesis board

**Goal.** Can every allele in scope be expressed as one normalized record that every model class can read — genomic change, transcript, protein change, DNA window, protein window — with lineage?

| ID | Status | Confidence | Gene | Evidence | Claim |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [H058](h058-step-1.md) | supported | 0.95 | — | 3+ / 0− | P4-1a: at least 99 % of the callset's coding alleles get a non-null hgvs_p or hgvs_c from the VEP HGVS pass, so one normalized allele record can key every tier-1 model lookup. |
| [H071](h071-bub1b.md) | supported | 0.90 | BUB1B | 2+ / 0− | The protein half of P4-1: a wild-type and mutant amino-acid window can be built for essentially every missense allele in the record set from hgvs_p plus the Ensembl protein sequence, with no extra identifier lookup |
